# Election update: Monday, November 9 (morning)

## Bottom line
The House results table now marks 420 of 435 races called: D 257, R 163, with 218 needed for a majority ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). Counting FL-07, which two outlets report Ryan Elijah (R) won, it is D 257, R 164. In the Senate, Democrats have secured 54 seats to Republicans' 44, counting seats not up, with 51 needed ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Alaska and Mississippi are still uncalled, and USA Today reports legal fights loom in both ([USA Today](https://news.google.?oc=5)). No seat rated safe is within 5 points. With 90.5% of competitive races called, the tracker's forecaster scorecard is ready (Lessons learned, below).

## Lessons learned
From the tracker's scorecard, which compares each forecaster's final pre-election rating with races marked called ([scorecard](https://jakeworcester-byte.github.io/political-tracker/#results)):
- **Forecasters:** the consensus rating was right in 133 races and wrong in 18, and every miss went toward Democrats, among them NV-02, FL-09, MN-01 and NC-06, a seat rated Solid R. Of the 16 races the consensus called a Tossup, Democrats won 15.
- **Who did best:** RealClearPolling had the highest hit rate on non-tossup calls (94.2%), but it left 29 races as Tossups; among outlets that rated nearly every race, Silver Bulletin (90.6%) and Split Ticket (91.0%) led. The Economist (86.1%) and Inside Elections (86.8%) trailed.
- **Markets:** Polymarket's final prices gave Democrats 94.5% for the House and 76.5% for the Senate; Democrats won both.
- **Polls:** too few called races have vote shares in the table to judge yet (one so far).

## Coverage note
- **Parser:** the results tables parsed (435 House, 35 Senate) and the parser check is healthy.
- **News errors:** 2 of 17 race news queries failed (HTTP 503 from Google News), so AZ-02 and NC-03 have no fresh lead.
- **Court records:** CourtListener used (3 requests; 24 election dockets and 1 opinion).
- **Scorecard:** ready; vote shares are still sparse, so the poll check will fill in over the coming days.
